summary: Federal Home Loan Bank of Chicago filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a second-quarter 2026 dividend and provide non-binding dividend guidance for the next two quarters. The filing attaches a letter to members referencing a July 22 press release with preliminary Q2 results. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation. It does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or structural corporate event. The guidance is explicitly non-guaranteed and subject to market and regulatory conditions. No deal terms, prices, or premiums apply. What to watch: none; merely a standard cooperative bank capital-distribution communication.
